mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate at or below 0.2% compresses risk-free discount rates and elevates equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 5.0% over 3 months signals strengthening labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings to produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) above 12-month moving averages indicate robust economic demand and supply chain resilience, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when both HOUST and INDPRO exceed 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In low inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 2.5% annualized), a federal funds rate decline below 0.2% triggers monetary easing that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 900 thousand units signals strong residential demand, correlating with rising household income and consumption to generate positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST > 900.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) rising above 105.0 (index 2017=100) over 1 month indicates accelerating manufacturing output, strengthening economic conditions and corporate earnings to yield positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO > 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payrolls (PAYEMS) above 140,000 thousand and retail sales (RSAFS) above 430,000 million dollars indicate labor market strength and rising consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when both PAYEMS > 140000 and RSAFS > 430000.

mechanism_narrative: In rising inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized), a stable federal funds rate at or below 0.2% maintains accommodative policy, supporting equity returns to produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2%.
